name: Collapse
description: A single disclosure: a button that shows and hides one region, such as advanced settings, or a read-more that clamps long text behind a fade.

livewire.name: collapse
capabilities: Slots: trigger replaces label; the deprecated heading and content slots still render

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the region shows. Livewire binds it with wire:model, Vue with v-model:open. Setting it doesn't fire open-change.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Whether an uncontrolled collapse starts open.

props.name: variant
props.description: Section hides the region while closed. Read-more shows its first lines behind a fade and puts the trigger after them. Emitted as data-variant.

props.name: label
props.description: The trigger's text: say what will appear (Advanced settings). Read-more defaults it to Read more; Livewire translates the default with __().

props.name: openLabel
props.description: The trigger's text while open, when it should change. Read-more defaults it to Show less; Livewire translates the default with __().

props.name: disabled
props.description: The trigger can't be focused or toggled.

props.name: classes
props.description: Extra classes per part, such as { trigger: '…', content: '…' }.

parts.name: root
parts.description: Holds the trigger and the region. data-state is open or closed.

parts.name: trigger
parts.description: The button: aria-expanded, and aria-controls the region. Before the region in a section, after it in a read-more.

parts.name: icon
parts.description: The chevron at the trigger's end; it turns up while open. Zag's indicator.

parts.name: content
parts.description: The region. A section's is hidden while closed; a read-more's is clamped to --apui-collapse-clamp-height. The spec calls it panel; it keeps Zag's name (D-019).

parts.name: fade
parts.description: Read-more only: the gradient over the clamped text's last line, hidden while open. aria-hidden.

events.name: open-change
events.description: The region opened or closed from the trigger. Setting open doesn't fire it.

keyboard.action: Moves from the trigger into the open region.

requirements: The trigger is a button with aria-expanded and aria-controls; a section's region follows it in the DOM.
A closed section's region is hidden; a closed read-more's text stays in the accessibility tree, only clamped visually.
The fade is decorative and aria-hidden.
The trigger's text says what will appear, and the chevron is aria-hidden.
Don't clamp text that holds the main point.
The focus ring shows on the trigger.

fixture.content: Twenty-four bright apartments around a shared garden courtyard, five minutes from the tram. Most units face south with private balconies. The building was renovated in 2024 with new windows, heat pumps and a rooftop terrace.
